Software Engineering Intern, Backend

About the role

You will build and test backend services and REST APIs used by our product teams.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build RESTful APIs in Python or Java
  • Write unit and integration tests and ship through CI/CD
  • Profile and optimize SQL queries in PostgreSQL
  • Deploy services with Docker on AWS

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
  • Experience with Python, SQL and Git
  • Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms

Nice to have

  • Experience with Kafka, Redis or Kubernetes
  • Exposure to React or TypeScript
